matrix.title: Editable source and safe host save

harness.observed: Edited and saved through the fixture bus; dirty indicator cleared only on acknowledgement. Ctrl+Shift+Q prompted before quitting in main editor and popout. Real owned-hub test saved, rejected stale content, forced overwrite; twelve competing host saves produced exactly one winner. Older hub refusal sends no unconditional write.

matrix.limitations: OS advisory lock coordinates fs.write/fs.compareWrite on the opened file, including multiple clients/processes; outside writers ignoring the lock or replacing the inode can still race. Readback detects some later changes. No filesystem-wide atomic CAS or crash-atomic replacement claim. Old hubs require upgrade for editor saves. Remote-shaped paths tested over a fake WebSocket and real embedded hub; no TLS remote machine exercised. Cmd+Q covered by GPUI regression, not macOS runtime.
